visual_action: The video is a slideshow of two still images. The first is a photo of Donald Trump looking somber at a podium. The second is a photo of Joe Biden smiling while wearing aviator sunglasses.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown in the first image, and the text "The last guy talked about infrastructure for years..." refers to him.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is shown in the second image, and the text "President Biden delivered historic infrastructure investments..." refers to him.

on_screen_text.text: The last guy talked about infrastructure for years...
President Biden delivered historic infrastructure investments to the American people

audio_music: The video features the instrumental song "The Winner Is..." by DeVotchKa. The music starts with a simple, slightly pensive tone over the image of Donald Trump, then swells into a triumphant, uplifting crescendo over the image of Joe Biden, creating an emotional contrast and a feeling of victory.
cultural_references: The Winner Is... (song from the movie Little Miss Sunshine)
central_claim: While Donald Trump only talked about infrastructure, Joe Biden successfully delivered historic infrastructure investments to the American people.
intended_effect: To create a feeling of pride in President Biden's accomplishments and portray him as more effective than his predecessor.
